title: 52 Days with Dynabook K50/FP on Omarchy

title: 🌍 The Punished Developer: How AI Sanctions Target Us, Not Governments

title: The Art of Desktop Ergonomics: Micro-Tweaks That Transform Your Workflow

author: Ehsan Tork

title: From Python to Rust: The Rewrite That Shrunk an Enterprise App by 90% and Saved the Project

author: Ehsan Tork

title: The Enterprise OS Revolution: Building a Self-Healing, Read-Only Workstation Platform

We envisioned something different—a self-healing, secure-by-design workstation platform that could manage itself while empowering users.
author: Ehsan Tork
